newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian lending rate dips to 10.7 vs 11.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Croatian lending rate dips to 10.7 vs 11.5 pct.

text.p: Croatian average lending rate dipped to 10.7 percent on Tuesday from 11.5 percent on slightly improved kuna supply.
Trade totalled 25 million kuna ($4.2 million) against some 29 million in supply and 18 million were fresh loans.
They were mostly call money deals at 10.5 percent rate again, down from Monday's weighted 11.2 percent.
Insurers rolled over two-week loans at 9.0 percent and banks at 13 percent. They renewed old call money deals at 10.5.
The central bank calculated its kuna midrates for Wednesday weaker at 6.0712 to the dollar and 3.5677 to the German mark. -- Metka Jelenc, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075 ($ = 6.006 Croatian Kuna)
